question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Credit
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. Debit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Credit**' refers to the addition of an amount to a bank account or the acknowledgment of someone's contribution to something.

 
 
• **Example:** If you receive your salary, it is credited to your bank account.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym, '**Debit**', refers to the withdrawal of an amount from a bank account.
 
 
• **Example:** When you buy something using your debit card, the amount is debited from your account.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Debit**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Litigate:** To engage in legal proceedings. 
 
• **Install:** To set up or establish something, especially software or machinery.
 
• **Impute:** To attribute or ascribe something, especially fault or blame, to someone.
